The '''Alliance Fleet trooper uniform''' is a uniform worn by [[Rebel Marine|Alliance Fleet troopers]] during their service in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. This uniform was also worn by [[Rebel Marine]]s and [[Rebel Vanguard/Legends|Rebel vanguards]] as a standard service uniform.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

Other variants of the uniform were worn by [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] officers and [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance Army]] troops.

==Description==
The uniform comprised a pale blue tunic and grey-brown trousers. Over the tunic was worn a black vest with webbing for holding weapons, powerpacks and equipment. The vest also provided minimal protection against light blaster fire, but was ineffective against the heavy [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] of the Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] that boarded the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="ANH" />

Other parts of the uniform was the helmet, which was made out of plasteroid material. The helmet was generally colored white and featured a forward face visor. In some cases, the uniform was also worn with a soft garrison cap.
